ios.desc:
Channel Lab does 4 things:

1. Filters out low-quality, potentially harmful YT kids channels and Shorts.
2. Preselected quality channels by REAL people, not AI.
3. Parents can add their favorite channels
4. Advanced screentime management that encourages a healthy, active lifestyle

Your kids will enjoy watching UTube kids content that they actually learn from. We have curated the perfect balance of educational/entertaining.

Reduce overstimulation!

Key Features:

Incredible Kids Daily News features true stories of kids that have accomplished  amazing things. Watch and read.

A+ YouTube Channels Only: Each channel is carefully selected for its quality subject matter, positive attitudes, and entertainment value. YT channels are also chosen that stimulate children's knowledge and social development.

No Unfiltered Search: Protect your children from harmful content and overstimulation. Our managed YouTube player blocks unrestricted video or channel searches, ensuring that your kids only access age-appropriate and beneficial content.

No External Recommendations: Our app blocks YouTube's recommendation algorithm, meaning no more unwanted or potentially harmful uTube videos suggestions. We strive to provide a safe and conducive digital environment for kids.

Screen time can be easily managed, along with YouTube watch history.



Developer: Design Overhaul

Supports: Family Sharing (Up to 6 family members can use this app)
